evaluation_question: 固定された証拠と条件から中立的な推奨を返し、未知と利益・負担を正しく扱えるか
hypothesis: 判断境界と限定検証の指示で、見送りと相乗効果を根拠付きで扱える
counter_hypothesis: 指示が過剰調査、保留、組み合わせ推奨を増やす

execution.generator_isolation: Fresh agents receive frozen skill and prompt-only files, no rubric or earlier conversation. Cases are grouped within each agent; not per-case context isolation.
execution.blind_grading: Separate fresh grader receives rubric and outputs, not skill, implementation, or requested overall verdict.

gate.limits: Public synthetic cases. No comparative superiority, unseen holdout, automatic discovery, or real deployment claim.
